headline: Variance approved for two-story ADU replacing garage at 7 Fairview Ave
summary: The applicants are Jericho Houle, and the owners are Jacinta Gagnon and Jeremy Houle. The existing garage would be replaced with a two-story unit on its current foundation, about 6 ft from the property line where 15 ft is required. Living area is capped at 950 sq ft, and state and town permits and inspections are required. Anyone aggrieved by the decision has 30 days to appeal.
decisions: Approved 5-0 a variance at 7 Fairview Ave to replace a garage with a two-story ADU about 6 ft from the property line, with living area capped at 950 sq ft.
discussion: Foundation reuse: Members questioned whether the existing foundation could hold a second story. Code enforcement said a replacement would have to stay in the same location to fall under this variance.
Height and setback: Board members said the variance is needed because the garage would go from one floor to two, which affects the setback.

Hardship: The applicants said the existing foundation and yard layout created hardship, and that moving the foundation would be costly and disruptive. Board members said the hardship criterion was met.
Living area limit: Storage and utility space count toward the 950 square foot maximum, staff said. The board added a condition that living area not exceed 950 sq ft.

decision_evidence.quote: I make a motion on case number 26-134 to grant a variance to the terms of article 6 section 1 65-45.1.B.D of the town of Derry zoning ordinance... Congratulations, this has succeeded by a vote of 5 to 0.

decision_titles: Setback variance for two-story ADU at 7 Fairview Ave
